mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settle_member ( member_id, member_name, status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_name = VALUES(member_name), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, member_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_member WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY member_id ASC
